declarations.type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (block : Fin n → Fin m) (A D N : Research.BlockJacobi.RealMatrix n) (b x : Research.BlockJacobi.Vector n),
  Research.BlockJacobi.IsBlockSplitting block A D N →
    IsUnit.{0} (Matrix.det.{0, 0} D) →
      Eq.{1} (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} A x) b →
        have P := Research.BlockJacobi.iterationMatrix D N;
        And
          (And (Eq.{1} D (Research.BlockJacobi.diagonalBlocks block A))
            (Eq.{1} N (Research.BlockJacobi.offDiagonalBlocks block A)))
          (And
            (∀ (x₀ : Research.BlockJacobi.Vector n),
              And (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockJacobi.iterate A D b x₀ 0) x₀)
                (∀ (k : Nat),
                  And
                    (Eq.{1}
                      (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} D
                        (Research.BlockJacobi.correctionSequence A D b x₀ (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1)))
                      (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} b (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} A (Research.BlockJacobi.iterate A D b x₀ k))))
                    (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockJacobi.iterate A D b x₀ (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1))
                      (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (Research.BlockJacobi.iterate A D b x₀ k)
                        (Research.BlockJacobi.correctionSequence A D b x₀ (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1))))))
            (And
              (∀ (x₀ : Research.BlockJacobi.Vector n) (X C : Nat → Research.BlockJacobi.Vector n),
                Eq.{1} (X 0) x₀ →
                  (∀ (k : Nat),
                      Eq.{1} (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} D (C (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1)))
                        (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} b (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} A (X k)))) →
                    (∀ (k : Nat),
                        Eq.{1} (X (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1))
                          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (X k) (C (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1)))) →
                      And (∀ (k : Nat), Eq.{1} (X k) (Research.BlockJacobi.iterate A D b x₀ k))
                        (∀ (k : Nat),
                          Eq.{1} (C (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1))
                            (Research.BlockJacobi.correctionSequence A D b x₀ (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1))))
              (And
                (∀ (x₀ : Research.BlockJacobi.Vector n) (k : Nat),
                  And
                    (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x₀ x (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1))
                      (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} P (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x₀ x k)))
                    (And
                      (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x₀ x k)
                        (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} P k) (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x₀ x 0)))
                      (And
                        (LE.le.{0} (Research.BlockJacobi.vectorAbs (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x₀ x k))
                          (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (Research.BlockJacobi.matrixAbs P) k)
                            (Research.BlockJacobi.vectorAbs (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x₀ x 0))))
                        (LE.le.{0} (Norm.norm.{0} (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x₀ x k))
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (Research.BlockJacobi.matrixInfNorm P) k)
                            (Norm.norm.{0} (Research.BlockJacobi.error A D b x₀ x 0)))))))
                (And
                  (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockJacobi.rho P)
                    (Research.BlockJacobi.rho (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Inv.inv.{0} D) N)))
                  (And
                    (Iff (Research.BlockJacobi.ConvergesForEveryInitialGuess A D b x)
                      (LT.lt.{0} (Research.BlockJacobi.rho P) 1))
                    (And
                      (∀ (u v : Research.BlockJacobi.Vector n),
                        LE.le.{0}
                          (Norm.norm.{0}
                            (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (Research.BlockJacobi.update A D b u)
                              (Research.BlockJacobi.update A D b v)))
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Research.BlockJacobi.matrixInfNorm P)
                            (Norm.norm.{0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} u v))))
                      (LT.lt.{0} (Research.BlockJacobi.matrixInfNorm P) 1 →
                        And (Research.BlockJacobi.ConvergesForEveryInitialGuess A D b x)
                          (∃ q,
                            And (Eq.{1} (↑q) (Research.BlockJacobi.matrixInfNorm P))
                              (And (LT.lt.{0} q 1) (LipschitzWith.{0, 0} q (Research.BlockJacobi.update A D b)))))))))))
